scripts.setup: pnpm i && pnpm --dir .agents install && pnpm --dir .agents setup:env
scripts.setup:full: pnpm setup && pnpm --dir .agents skills:install && pnpm setup:gitleaks && pnpm --dir .agents setup:osv && pnpm setup:portless && pnpm setup:deepsec && pnpm setup:playwright
scripts.setup:playwright: pnpm --filter web exec playwright install chromium
scripts.ci:local: pnpm qa && pnpm eval:genui:offline && pnpm test:browser && pnpm security:check && pnpm build
scripts.ci:factory:local: pnpm ci:local && pnpm --dir .agents commits:check --all && pnpm --dir .agents check:factory && pnpm --dir .agents test
scripts.hooks:ci-tests: pnpm security:block-files && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @repo/db db:check
scripts.hooks:pre-commit: pnpm security:block-files && pnpm security:secrets && node tooling/checks/check-staged.mjs && pnpm run hooks:ci-tests
scripts.qa: pnpm lint && pnpm knip && pnpm sherif && pnpm check-types && pnpm test && pnpm --filter @repo/db db:check
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @repo/genui test && pnpm --filter web test && pnpm --filter @repo/db test
scripts.security:deepsec:process:diff: pnpm --dir=.deepsec exec deepsec process --agent pi --model xai/grok-4.6 --thinking-level medium --diff origin/main
scripts.agentic:check: sh -c 'if [ -z "${AGENTIC_CHECK_URL:-}" ]; then echo "agentic:check requires AGENTIC_CHECK_URL (public host without scheme, e.g. vercel.com)"; exit 1; fi; case "$AGENTIC_CHECK_URL" in http://*|https://*) echo "agentic:check: omit https:// from AGENTIC_CHECK_URL"; exit 1;; esac; exec is-agentic "$AGENTIC_CHECK_URL"'
